<!--
  The CV is the PDF at cv/vlachos-cv.pdf, drawn into this page by
  assets/js/cv.js. To update the CV, replace that file; nothing on this page
  needs editing.
-->

```{=html}
<div class="cv-actions">
  <a class="btn-line is-disabled" href="vlachos-cv.pdf" download aria-disabled="true" data-cv-download><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf" aria-hidden="true"></i> Download PDF</a>
</div>

<div class="cv-viewer" data-cv-viewer="vlachos-cv.pdf">
  <p class="cv-status" data-cv-loading>Loading CV…</p>
  <p class="cv-status" data-cv-missing hidden>The PDF of my CV will appear here soon. <span class="placeholder-tag">placeholder</span></p>
</div>

<noscript><p><a href="vlachos-cv.pdf">Open the CV as a PDF</a>.</p></noscript>
<script type="module" src="/assets/js/cv.js"></script>
```
